name: 8.5 x 8.5 in picture book, 24 pages, KDP paperback, premium colour

image.$comment: What `npm run bot -- <role> image` asks for and what it may spend. Prices are fal.ai list prices read 2026-10-18 in the videograph repo; check them on fal's pages before raising a cap. maxAttemptsPerImage counts live paid attempts at one picture (a kind and a page or name) since its task last went in_progress; maxAttemptsLifetime counts every row, failures included, and only a person lifts it. perImageCapUsd is 3.5 x the kind's price (raised from 2.5 by Kyle on 2026-11-12: the first evening used 3.5 final attempts a page): a task may spend that much per picture it covers, per kind, in place of a flat task cap. maxPicturesPerTask stops a task growing its budget by inventing names. spread_draft (2026-11-12): one picture for a facing pair of pages (e.g. pp. 8-9), drawn wide and split down the middle into the left and right page; nothing that matters in the middle 8% (the fold). Its print-size kind comes with the first spread final.
